Mars.cn: 火星是一颗红色的行星。

Mars.en: Scientists want to send people to Mars.
Mars.cn: 科学家想把人类送上火星。

Mars.en: Living on Mars would mean facing thin air and freezing nights.
Mars.cn: 在火星上生活意味着要面对稀薄的空气和严寒的夜晚。

landing.en: The spacecraft made a soft landing on the surface.
landing.cn: 宇宙飞船在表面平稳着陆。

landing.en: A successful landing on Mars requires perfect timing and control.
landing.cn: 成功登陆火星需要完美的时机和控制。

surface.en: The surface of Mars is covered with red dust.
surface.cn: 火星的表面覆盖着红色的尘土。

surface.en: Rovers study the rocky surface to look for signs of water.
surface.cn: 探测车研究多岩的表面以寻找水的痕迹。

dust.en: There is dust on the table.
Strong winds blow red dust across Mars.
dust.cn: 强风把红色的尘土吹遍火星。

dust.en: Huge dust storms can cover the whole planet for weeks.
dust.cn: 巨大的沙尘暴能笼罩整个星球数周之久。

colony.cn: 他们建立了一个移居地。

colony.en: People dream of building a colony on Mars.
colony.cn: 人们梦想在火星上建立移居地。

colony.en: A Mars colony would need to grow its own food and make its own air.
colony.cn: 火星移居地需要自己种植食物并制造空气。

oxygen.cn: 我们需要氧气才能生存。

oxygen.en: There is very little oxygen on Mars.
oxygen.cn: 火星上的氧气非常稀少。

oxygen.en: Scientists are testing machines that can make oxygen from Martian air.
oxygen.cn: 科学家正在测试能从火星空气中制造氧气的机器。

gravity.en: The gravity on Mars is weaker than on Earth.
gravity.cn: 火星上的重力比地球上的弱。

gravity.en: Low gravity could make human bones weaker over time.
gravity.cn: 低重力可能会让人的骨骼随时间变得更弱。

rover.en: The rover sent photos back to Earth.
rover.cn: 火星车把照片传回了地球。

rover.en: The rover drilled into rocks to search for ancient life.
rover.cn: 火星车钻入岩石以寻找古老的生命迹象。

crater.en: A large crater was formed by a falling rock.
crater.cn: 一块坠落的岩石形成了一个巨大的环形山。

crater.en: Scientists believe some craters once held lakes of water.
crater.cn: 科学家认为有些环形山曾经存有湖水。

temperature.en: The temperature on Mars can drop far below zero.
temperature.cn: 火星上的温度会降到远低于零度。

temperature.en: The huge change in temperature between day and night makes survival hard.
temperature.cn: 昼夜间巨大的温度变化使生存变得艰难。

greenhouse.en: A greenhouse could help grow food on Mars.
greenhouse.cn: 温室能帮助在火星上种植食物。

greenhouse.en: Inside a sealed greenhouse, settlers might grow vegetables in red soil.
greenhouse.cn: 在密封的温室里，定居者也许能在红色土壤中种菜。

explore.cn: 我们去探索这个洞穴吧。

explore.en: Humans have always wanted to explore space.
explore.cn: 人类一直渴望探索太空。

explore.en: Robots explore distant planets that are too dangerous for people.
explore.cn: 机器人探索那些对人类来说太危险的遥远星球。

dangerous.en: Travelling to Mars is dangerous and difficult.
dangerous.cn: 前往火星既危险又困难。

dangerous.en: Space radiation makes long journeys extremely dangerous for astronauts.
dangerous.cn: 太空辐射使长途旅行对宇航员极为危险。

possible.en: New technology makes space travel possible.
possible.cn: 新科技使太空旅行成为可能。

possible.en: Scientists believe it may one day be possible for humans to live on Mars.
possible.cn: 科学家相信有朝一日人类或许能在火星上生活。

technology.en: Modern technology has changed our daily lives.
technology.cn: 现代科技改变了我们的日常生活。

technology.en: Advanced technology allows us to explore worlds far beyond Earth.
technology.cn: 先进的科技让我们能探索远在地球之外的世界。

blind.en: The blind man uses a stick.
She became blind when she was very young.
blind.cn: 她在很小的时候就失明了。

blind.en: Though blind, she learned to read with her fingers and never gave up.
blind.cn: 尽管失明，她仍学会用手指阅读，从不放弃。

deaf.en: He is deaf in one ear.
The deaf girl learned to speak with great effort.
deaf.cn: 这个失聪的女孩费尽努力学会了说话。

deaf.en: Being both deaf and blind, she still became a famous writer.
deaf.cn: 尽管又聋又盲，她仍成为了著名作家。

courage.en: It takes courage to speak the truth.
Great leaders show courage even when everyone else is afraid.
courage.cn: 伟大的领袖即使在众人恐惧时也展现勇气。

struggle.en: They had to struggle against poverty.
struggle.cn: 他们不得不与贫困抗争。

struggle.en: Her long struggle for equal rights inspired millions of people.
struggle.cn: 她为平等权利的长期奋斗激励了千百万人。

overcome.en: She worked hard to overcome her difficulties.
overcome.cn: 她努力克服自己的困难。

overcome.en: He overcame his fear and disability to achieve his dream.
overcome.cn: 他克服了恐惧和残疾，实现了梦想。

achieve.en: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
achieve.cn: 她努力工作以实现目标。

achieve.en: Great people achieve success through years of effort and courage.
achieve.cn: 伟人通过多年的努力和勇气取得成功。

leader.en: A good leader cares about his people.
leader.cn: 好的领袖关心他的人民。

leader.en: A true leader guides others with both wisdom and kindness.
leader.cn: 真正的领袖以智慧和善良引领他人。

freedom.en: Many people fought for their freedom.
He spent his whole life fighting for the freedom of his people.
freedom.cn: 他一生都在为人民的自由而奋斗。

equality.en: He believed in equality for all people.
Her speech called for equality between people of every race.
equality.cn: 她的演讲呼吁各种族人民之间的平等。

speech.en: Her speech moved the whole audience.
speech.cn: 她的演讲打动了全场观众。

speech.en: His famous speech about a dream changed the course of history.
speech.cn: 他那篇关于梦想的著名演讲改变了历史的进程。

biography.en: The biography tells the story of his life.
biography.cn: 这本传记讲述了他一生的故事。

biography.en: Reading the biography of a great leader can teach us many lessons.
biography.cn: 阅读一位伟大领袖的传记能让我们学到许多道理。

admire.en: People admire him for his courage.
admire.cn: 人们因他的勇气而钦佩他。

admire.en: We admire those who fight for others without thinking of themselves.
admire.cn: 我们钦佩那些为他人奋斗而不考虑自己的人。

selfless.en: His selfless work helped many poor people.
selfless.cn: 他无私的工作帮助了许多穷人。

selfless.en: Her selfless devotion to others made her a true hero.
selfless.cn: 她对他人无私的奉献使她成为真正的英雄。

generation.en: Each generation learns from the one before it.
generation.cn: 每一代人都从前一代人身上学习。

generation.en: His brave deeds have inspired generation after generation.
generation.cn: 他的英勇事迹激励了一代又一代人。

role model.en: A good teacher can be a role model for students.
role model.cn: 一位好老师可以成为学生的榜样。

role model.en: Great leaders become role models who inspire us to be better people.
role model.cn: 伟大的领袖成为激励我们成为更好的人的榜样。

continent.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
continent.cn: 亚洲是世界上最大的大洲。

continent.en: The continent of Asia is home to many different peoples and cultures.
continent.cn: 亚洲大陆是众多不同民族和文化的家园。

population.en: Asia has the largest population of any continent.
population.cn: 亚洲是人口最多的大洲。

population.en: A growing population brings both opportunities and challenges to a country.
population.cn: 不断增长的人口给一个国家带来机遇与挑战。

culture.en: Asia is rich in different cultures.
culture.cn: 亚洲拥有丰富多样的文化。

culture.en: Each country in Asia has its own unique culture and history.
culture.cn: 亚洲的每个国家都有自己独特的文化和历史。

tradition.en: Many Asian families keep their old traditions.
tradition.cn: 许多亚洲家庭保留着古老的传统。

tradition.en: Ancient traditions are passed down from one generation to the next.
tradition.cn: 古老的传统一代代地传承下来。

desert.en: There are large deserts in central Asia.
Few plants can survive in the dry, sandy desert.
desert.cn: 很少有植物能在干燥多沙的沙漠中存活。

plateau.en: Tibet lies on a high plateau.
plateau.cn: 西藏位于一片高原之上。

plateau.en: The plateau is so high that the air there is thin and cold.
plateau.cn: 这片高原如此之高，那里的空气稀薄而寒冷。

river.en: The Yangtze is the longest river in Asia.
river.cn: 长江是亚洲最长的河流。

river.en: Great rivers have given life to ancient cities along their banks.
river.cn: 大河为沿岸的古老城市带来了生命。

mountain.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth.
mountain.cn: 珠穆朗玛峰是地球上最高的山。

mountain.en: Climbers from all over the world come to challenge this mountain.
mountain.cn: 来自世界各地的登山者前来挑战这座山。

diverse.en: Asia has a diverse mix of people and languages.
diverse.cn: 亚洲有多种多样的民族和语言。

diverse.en: Its diverse cultures make Asia one of the most fascinating continents.
diverse.cn: 多样的文化使亚洲成为最迷人的大洲之一。

religion.en: Many great religions began in Asia.
religion.cn: 许多伟大的宗教都起源于亚洲。

religion.en: People of different religions have lived together here for centuries.
religion.cn: 不同宗教的人们在这里共同生活了数百年。

economy.en: Asia's economy is developing very fast.
economy.cn: 亚洲的经济发展得非常快。

economy.en: A strong economy can lift millions of people out of poverty.
economy.cn: 强劲的经济能让数百万人摆脱贫困。

ancient.en: China has an ancient and rich history.
ancient.cn: 中国有着悠久而丰富的历史。

ancient.en: Ancient Asian civilizations gave the world paper, silk and gunpowder.
ancient.cn: 古代亚洲文明给世界带来了纸张、丝绸和火药。

modern.en: Modern Asia is full of busy, growing cities.
modern.cn: 现代亚洲遍布繁忙而发展中的城市。

modern.en: Modern Asia mixes old traditions with new technology.
modern.cn: 现代亚洲将古老传统与新科技融合在一起。

landscape.en: Asia has many kinds of landscape.
landscape.cn: 亚洲有多种多样的风景。

landscape.en: From snowy mountains to green forests, Asia's landscape is amazing.
landscape.cn: 从雪山到绿林，亚洲的风景令人惊叹。

unite.en: The two groups decided to unite.
unite.cn: 这两个团体决定联合起来。

unite.en: Many nations chose to unite to solve their common problems.
unite.cn: 许多国家选择联合起来以解决共同的问题。

world.en: People all over the world share one Earth.
world.cn: 全世界的人共享一个地球。

world.en: We must work together to make the world a better place.
world.cn: 我们必须共同努力，让世界变得更美好。

earth.en: The Earth is our only home.
earth.cn: 地球是我们唯一的家园。

earth.en: We must protect the Earth for future generations.
earth.cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护地球。

ocean.en: The ocean covers most of the Earth.
ocean.cn: 海洋覆盖了地球的大部分。

ocean.en: Pollution is harming the fish and plants that live in the ocean.
ocean.cn: 污染正在伤害生活在海洋中的鱼类和植物。

climate.en: Climate change is a serious problem.
climate.cn: 气候变化是一个严重的问题。

climate.en: Rising temperatures are changing the climate all over the world.
climate.cn: 不断上升的气温正在改变全世界的气候。

nature.en: We should live in harmony with nature.
nature.cn: 我们应该与大自然和谐相处。

nature.en: Protecting nature is the duty of every person on Earth.
nature.cn: 保护大自然是地球上每个人的责任。

resource.en: We should not waste natural resources.
resource.cn: 我们不应浪费自然资源。

resource.en: The Earth's resources are limited, so we must use them wisely.
resource.cn: 地球的资源是有限的，因此我们必须明智地利用它们。

wildlife.en: We must protect wildlife in the forests.
wildlife.cn: 我们必须保护森林中的野生动物。

wildlife.en: Cutting down forests destroys the homes of much wildlife.
wildlife.cn: 砍伐森林会摧毁许多野生动物的家园。

balance.cn: 大自然有它自己的平衡。

balance.en: Human activities can easily upset the balance of nature.
balance.cn: 人类活动很容易打破大自然的平衡。

pollution.en: We must reduce pollution to protect our health and our planet.
pollution.cn: 我们必须减少污染以保护健康和我们的星球。

endangered.en: Many endangered animals need our protection.
endangered.cn: 许多濒危动物需要我们的保护。

endangered.en: If we do nothing, endangered species may disappear forever.
endangered.cn: 如果我们无所作为，濒危物种可能会永远消失。

melt.en: The ice is melting because of global warming.
melt.cn: 由于全球变暖，冰正在融化。

melt.en: As the ice melts, sea levels rise and threaten coastal cities.
melt.cn: 随着冰融化，海平面上升并威胁沿海城市。

cooperate.en: Countries must cooperate to protect the Earth.
cooperate.cn: 各国必须合作以保护地球。

cooperate.en: Only when nations cooperate can we solve global problems.
cooperate.cn: 只有当各国合作，我们才能解决全球性问题。

treaty.en: Many countries signed the treaty to protect nature.
treaty.cn: 许多国家签署了保护自然的条约。

treaty.en: An international treaty asks every nation to cut its pollution.
treaty.cn: 一项国际条约要求每个国家减少污染。

future.en: Our choices today shape the future.
future.cn: 我们今天的选择塑造未来。

future.en: We must act now to protect the future of our planet.
future.cn: 我们必须现在就行动，以保护我们星球的未来。

hope.en: There is still hope for our planet.
If we all work together, there is hope for a greener world.
hope.cn: 如果我们共同努力，绿色世界就有希望。

festival.en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
festival.cn: 春节是中国最重要的节日。

festival.en: During the festival, families travel home to be together.
festival.cn: 节日期间，家人们都会赶回家团聚。

celebrate.en: People celebrate the New Year with their families.
celebrate.cn: 人们和家人一起庆祝新年。

celebrate.en: Communities celebrate the harvest with music, food and dancing.
celebrate.cn: 社区用音乐、美食和舞蹈来庆祝丰收。

lunar.en: The Chinese New Year follows the lunar calendar.
The date of the festival changes each year because it is lunar.
lunar.cn: 由于按阴历计算，这个节日的日期每年都不同。

firecracker.en: People set off firecrackers at New Year.
The loud firecrackers are said to drive away bad luck.
firecracker.cn: 据说响亮的爆竹能驱走霉运。

lantern.en: People hang red lanterns during the festival.
lantern.cn: 人们在节日期间挂红灯笼。

lantern.en: On Lantern Festival night, the whole street glows with bright lanterns.
lantern.cn: 元宵节之夜，整条街都被明亮的灯笼照亮。

reunion.en: The festival is a time for family reunion.
reunion.cn: 这个节日是家人团圆的时刻。

reunion.en: No matter how far away, people travel home for the reunion dinner.
reunion.cn: 无论多远，人们都会赶回家吃团圆饭。

blessing.en: Older people give blessings to children.
blessing.cn: 长辈给孩子们送上祝福。

blessing.en: During the festival, people send blessings of health and happiness.
blessing.cn: 节日期间，人们送上健康和幸福的祝福。

decorate.en: People decorate their homes for the festival.
Families decorate their doors with red couplets for good luck.
decorate.cn: 家家户户在门上贴红对联以求好运。

dumpling.en: We eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
Making dumplings together is a happy part of the family reunion.
dumpling.cn: 一起包饺子是家庭团聚中快乐的一部分。

mooncake.en: People eat mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
The round mooncake stands for family togetherness and the full moon.
mooncake.cn: 圆圆的月饼象征着家人团圆和满月。

dragon.en: People perform the dragon dance at festivals.
dragon.cn: 人们在节日里表演舞龙。

dragon.en: In Chinese culture, the dragon is a symbol of power and good luck.
dragon.cn: 在中国文化中，龙是力量和好运的象征。

carnival.en: The carnival is full of music and colour.
carnival.cn: 狂欢节充满了音乐和色彩。

carnival.en: During the carnival, people dance through the streets in bright costumes.
carnival.cn: 狂欢节期间，人们身着鲜艳服装在街头舞蹈。

harvest.cn: 农民们庆祝秋季的丰收。

harvest.en: The festival began as a way to give thanks for a good harvest.
harvest.cn: 这个节日起初是为了感谢丰收。

gather.en: The whole family gathers for the festival.
People gather under the full moon to share food and stories.
gather.cn: 人们在满月下相聚，分享食物和故事。

custom.en: Every country has its own customs.
custom.cn: 每个国家都有自己的习俗。

custom.en: Learning local customs helps visitors avoid awkward mistakes.
custom.cn: 了解当地习俗能帮助游客避免尴尬的错误。

polite.en: It is polite to say thank you.
What is polite in one country may be rude in another.
polite.cn: 在一个国家有礼貌的事在另一个国家可能很无礼。

rude.en: It is rude to point at people.
rude.cn: 用手指着别人是不礼貌的。

rude.en: A gesture that seems friendly here may look rude somewhere else.
rude.cn: 在这里看似友好的手势在别处可能显得无礼。

behaviour.en: His behaviour surprised the foreign guests.
behaviour.cn: 他的行为让外国客人感到惊讶。

behaviour.en: Acceptable behaviour can be very different from culture to culture.
behaviour.cn: 可接受的行为在不同文化间可能大相径庭。

foreign.en: She is learning a foreign language.
Living in a foreign country teaches you to respect new ways of life.
foreign.cn: 在外国生活会教会你尊重新的生活方式。

abroad.en: Many students want to study abroad.
Travelling abroad opens your eyes to different cultures and ideas.
abroad.cn: 出国旅行让你看到不同的文化与观念。

adapt.en: It takes time to adapt to a new country.
adapt.cn: 适应一个新国家需要时间。

adapt.en: Those who adapt quickly enjoy life abroad far more.
adapt.cn: 适应得快的人在国外的生活会愉快得多。

misunderstanding.en: A small misunderstanding can cause big trouble.
misunderstanding.cn: 一个小误解可能引起大麻烦。

misunderstanding.en: Cultural differences often lead to misunderstandings between people.
misunderstanding.cn: 文化差异常常导致人们之间的误解。

gesture.en: The same gesture can mean different things.
gesture.cn: 同样的手势可能有不同的含义。

gesture.en: A friendly gesture in one culture may offend people in another.
gesture.cn: 在一种文化中友好的手势在另一种文化中可能冒犯他人。

greeting.en: People use different greetings around the world.
greeting.cn: 世界各地的人用不同的方式问候。

greeting.en: In some countries a bow is the proper greeting, not a handshake.
greeting.cn: 在有些国家，鞠躬而非握手才是恰当的问候方式。

respect.cn: 我们应该尊重其他文化。

respect.en: Showing respect for local customs makes you a welcome guest.
respect.cn: 尊重当地习俗会让你成为受欢迎的客人。

curiosity.en: Curiosity makes us want to learn about other cultures.
curiosity.cn: 好奇心使我们想要了解其他文化。

curiosity.en: A healthy curiosity helps travellers understand a new place.
curiosity.cn: 健康的好奇心能帮助旅行者理解一个新地方。

tolerate.cn: 我们应该容忍不同的观点。

tolerate.en: Learning to tolerate differences is the key to living in peace.
tolerate.cn: 学会容忍差异是和平共处的关键。

experience.en: Living abroad was a valuable experience for her.
experience.cn: 在国外生活对她来说是一次宝贵的经历。

experience.en: The experience of another culture changed the way he saw the world.
experience.cn: 异国文化的经历改变了他看待世界的方式。

poetry.en: Chinese poetry has a long history.
poetry.cn: 中国诗歌有着悠久的历史。

poetry.en: Good poetry can express deep feelings in just a few words.
poetry.cn: 好的诗歌能用寥寥数语表达深刻的情感。

poem.en: She read a beautiful poem aloud.
poem.cn: 她大声朗读了一首优美的诗。

poem.en: This famous poem describes the beauty of a moonlit night.
poem.cn: 这首著名的诗描绘了月夜的美。

poet.en: Li Bai was a great Chinese poet.
poet.cn: 李白是一位伟大的中国诗人。

poet.en: A skilled poet can turn ordinary scenes into beautiful images.
poet.cn: 技艺高超的诗人能把平凡的景象化为优美的意象。

rhyme.en: The two lines rhyme with each other.
The poet used rhyme to make the poem pleasant to read aloud.
rhyme.cn: 诗人运用押韵使这首诗朗读起来悦耳动听。

rhythm.en: The poem has a strong rhythm.
The rhythm of the words makes the poem feel like music.
rhythm.cn: 词语的节奏使这首诗听起来像音乐。

verse.en: She learned the first verse by heart.
verse.cn: 她把第一节诗背了下来。

verse.en: Each verse of the poem tells a part of the story.
verse.cn: 诗的每一节都讲述故事的一部分。

image.en: The poem creates a beautiful image of spring.
image.cn: 这首诗创造了一幅美丽的春天意象。

image.en: Poets use vivid images to help readers see and feel the scene.
image.cn: 诗人用生动的意象帮助读者看到并感受场景。

metaphor.en: He used a metaphor to describe time.
The metaphor compares life to a long and winding road.
metaphor.cn: 这个暗喻把人生比作一条漫长曲折的道路。

simile.en: "As brave as a lion" is a simile.
simile.cn: “像狮子一样勇敢”是一个明喻。

simile.en: A simile uses "like" or "as" to compare two different things.
simile.cn: 明喻用“像”或“如”来比较两个不同的事物。

emotion.en: The poem is full of emotion.
Poetry helps us share emotions that are hard to put into words.
emotion.cn: 诗歌帮助我们分享难以用言语表达的情感。

inspire.en: The poem inspired many young writers.
inspire.cn: 这首诗激励了许多年轻作家。

inspire.en: Great poetry can inspire people to dream and to act.
inspire.cn: 伟大的诗歌能激励人们去梦想、去行动。

line.en: The first line of the poem is famous.
line.cn: 这首诗的第一行很有名。

line.en: Each line of the poem carries a deep and hidden meaning.
line.cn: 诗的每一行都蕴含着深刻而隐秘的意义。

stanza.en: The last stanza gives the poem a surprising ending.
stanza.cn: 最后一个诗节给这首诗一个出人意料的结尾。

translate.en: It is hard to translate poetry.
When you translate a poem, some of its beauty is often lost.
translate.cn: 翻译一首诗时，它的部分美感常常会丢失。

beauty.en: The poem describes the beauty of nature.
beauty.cn: 这首诗描绘了大自然的美。

beauty.en: True beauty in poetry comes from both sound and meaning.
beauty.cn: 诗歌中真正的美来自声音与意义。

literature.en: English literature is rich and varied.
Great literature helps us understand people from other times and places.
literature.cn: 伟大的文学帮助我们理解其他时代和地方的人。

novel.en: This novel tells an exciting story.
novel.cn: 这本小说讲了一个激动人心的故事。

novel.en: The novel explores how a poor boy grows into a brave man.
novel.cn: 这部小说探讨了一个穷孩子如何成长为勇敢的人。

story.en: The story has a happy ending.
story.cn: 这个故事有个圆满的结局。

story.en: A good story can teach us important lessons about life.
story.cn: 一个好故事能教给我们重要的人生道理。

author.en: The author wrote many famous books.
author.cn: 这位作者写了许多著名的书。

author.en: The author based the story on her own childhood.
author.cn: 这位作者以自己的童年为蓝本写了这个故事。

character.en: The main character is brave and kind.
A well-written character feels as real as a living person.
character.cn: 刻画得好的角色感觉就像活生生的人一样真实。

chapter.en: The last chapter is the most exciting.
chapter.cn: 最后一章是最激动人心的。

chapter.en: Each chapter ends in a way that makes you want to read on.
chapter.cn: 每一章的结尾都让你想继续读下去。

play.cn: 莎士比亚写了许多著名的戏剧。

play.en: The play shows the struggle between love and duty.
play.cn: 这出戏展现了爱情与责任之间的冲突。

tragedy.en: The play is a famous tragedy.
tragedy.cn: 这部戏是一出著名的悲剧。

tragedy.en: In a tragedy, the hero often falls because of one fatal mistake.
tragedy.cn: 在悲剧中，主人公常因一个致命的错误而走向毁灭。

comedy.cn: 这部喜剧让每个人都笑了。

comedy.en: A good comedy uses humour to show the truth about life.
comedy.cn: 好的喜剧用幽默来揭示生活的真相。

classic.en: This book is a classic of world literature.
classic.cn: 这本书是世界文学的经典。

classic.en: A classic is a book that people keep reading for many years.
classic.cn: 经典就是人们多年来不断阅读的书。

imagination.cn: 作家需要丰富的想象力。

imagination.en: A great story can carry our imagination to faraway worlds.
imagination.cn: 一个好故事能把我们的想象力带到遥远的世界。

fantasy.en: The fantasy story is full of magic.
fantasy.cn: 这个幻想故事充满了魔法。

fantasy.en: In a fantasy world, anything the writer imagines can come true.
fantasy.cn: 在幻想世界里，作家想象的任何事都能成真。

adventure.en: The book tells a story of adventure at sea.
adventure.cn: 这本书讲述了一个海上冒险的故事。

adventure.en: The young hero sets off on a dangerous adventure to save his friends.
adventure.cn: 年轻的主人公踏上危险的冒险去拯救他的朋友。

universal.cn: 这个故事探讨了普遍的情感。

universal.en: Great literature deals with universal themes that everyone understands.
universal.cn: 伟大的文学探讨人人都能理解的普遍主题。

influence.en: This writer had a big influence on others.
influence.cn: 这位作家对他人有很大的影响。

influence.en: The influence of these classic books can still be felt today.
influence.cn: 这些经典著作的影响至今仍能感受到。
